name: captcha-solver
description: Solve captchas and bot challenges (Turnstile, reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Cloudflare, AWS WAF and more) through a self-hosted captcha-solver service.
long_description: Gives the agent a solve_captcha tool that calls the captcha-solver /solve endpoint and a solver_status tool that checks the service. The API token is stored by the host, not shown to the model.

solver_url.title: Solver URL
solver_url.description: Base URL of the captcha-solver service.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Bearer token for the solver (SOLVER_API_TOKEN in the service's .solver-token.env).

api_host.title: API Host header
api_host.description: Only when the service uses host isolation (SOLVER_API_HOST set on the server). Leave empty otherwise.

tools.name: solve_captcha
tools.description: Solve a captcha or bot challenge and return the token or clearance.

tools.name: solver_status
tools.description: Check that the solver is up and list running tasks.
